messages:
maya: Quick postmortem follow-up: recurring vendor failures = cloud control-plane flares, model-registry rate limits, auth refresh storms. Need owners, short runbooks, and success metrics. Who can pick up?
tony: I can take control-plane. Short plan: client-side token-bucket, region failover rules, and a 5xx-aware circuit breaker. Deliverable: runbook + test harness. ETA: 8 working days.
celine: I'll own auth-provider mitigations. Quick wins: jittered refresh, tiny local token cache, and secondary-provider wiring. Blocking: security needs KMS rotation window.
dave: I'll handle model-registry throttles. Plan: prefetch hot artifacts, read-only fallback serving last-known-good, and a low-overhead warmup cron. Canary: 5% staging -> 10% prod.
ops-bot: Created epic INF-9712: "vendor-dep-mitigations". Link: https://redwood.internal/INF-9712. Default due: 2027-08-01.
maya: Owners add 1-line subtasks to INF-9712 by EOD Wed and include success metrics (target: >=35% reduction in P99 spikes, <=1 incident/month per class within 45 days). Add rollback steps and oncall contacts.
tony: Pushing fallback config snippet to the epic:
```json
{"fallback_order":["local-cache","registry-readonly","graceful-degrade"],"retries":{"max_attempts":3,"backoff_ms":[200,600,1200]}}
```
celine: Vendor SLA request sent to auth-partner@vendor.example for burst policy, escalation path, and test endpoints.
dave: Adding canary plan and cron pre-warm at 03:00 UTC. I'll track memory/cost delta and tag tradeoffs if >8%.
maya: I'll schedule a 25m sync Fri to confirm owners and unblock sec. If you claimed an item, assign yourself in INF-9712 and paste a one-line plan. Keep deep discussion in the epic. :thumbsup:
